name: ctxai
description: Codebase intelligence and context engine for AI coding agents: search, symbol lookup, impact analysis, and context building via MCP.

tools.name: ctx_project
tools.description: Return the project overview: root, git, and counts of indexed files, symbols and dependencies.

tools.name: ctx_search
tools.description: Search the code graph for symbols or files by name, with optional kind and files filters.

tools.name: ctx_skeleton
tools.description: Return a body-less structural skeleton of a source file, preserving signatures, types and exports.

tools.name: ctx_symbol
tools.description: Details about a symbol: definition, kind, methods, references and dependencies.

tools.name: ctx_dependencies
tools.description: List the files and modules a given file imports.

tools.name: ctx_dependents
tools.description: List files that import a given file (reverse dependencies).

tools.name: ctx_impact
tools.description: Analyze files and symbols potentially affected by changing a symbol or file.

tools.name: ctx_context
tools.description: Build a compact, relevance-ranked context package for a coding task.

tools.name: ctx_changed
tools.description: List files and symbols changed since a git reference.

tools.name: ctx_diff
tools.description: Semantic diff: symbols added, modified or removed between two refs.
